events.title: Prize map shows four parallel money paths
events.text: Phase II offers 6 x $8,500 track first prizes, $9,000 Grand Champion, 2 x $8,500 Community Voting, $3,000 UI/UX, and 20 x $1,000 Finalist & Deployment awards. Total value is $223K+ including API credits.

events.title: Alpha & Data scoring rewards investor-grade insights
events.text: Mirana judges score Insight value 15, Data source quality 15, Investment utility 12, and Scalability & sustainability 8. Excellent means verifiable alpha or institutional-grade insights with robust data pipelines.

events.title: Mainnet deployment is preferred for final winners
events.text: Organizer answer: testnet deployment counts, but mainnet deployment is considered better for final winner selection.

events.title: Mantle ERC-8004 Identity Registry is live on mainnet
events.text: Byreal Ops shared Mantle registry address 0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432 as the identity registry for agent ID / ERC-8004 related work.

events.title: Argus positions around xStock depeg rescue
events.text: Competitor is building a non-custodial AI agent for tokenized stocks on Mantle, monitoring depeg risk using Pyth vs Fluxion and executing a rescue based on a pre-signed policy.

events.title: Strata crowds RWA yield with multi-agent protocol
events.text: Strata is a tranched real-world-asset yield protocol on Mantle managed by five autonomous agents with on-chain identity, verifiable decisions, and agent-to-agent communication.

events.title: LedgerForge crowds agent reputation marketplace
events.text: LedgerForge lets agents with verified on-chain reputation apply to jobs autonomously and earn when work is completed. Live on Mantle mainnet.

events.title: Tenki crowds natural-language backtesting
events.text: Tenki is an autonomous AI quant agent that turns natural-language strategies into backtests and anchors every result on-chain.

events.title: RealClaw is only required for Track 6
events.text: Organizer answer: projects outside Track 6 have no relation with Byreal RealClaw. Track 6 must use either Byreal Agent Skill or RealClaw.

events.title: 20 deployment awards details were delayed
events.text: Organizer answer: deployment award status was delayed because judging criteria had just been finalized. This makes deployment readiness a useful edge.
